title: Textual Toxicity in Social Media: Understanding the Bangla Toxic Language Expressed in Facebook Comment
reasoning: The research specifically categorizes and analyzes toxic language within thematic classes that include 'Religion / communal hate words' and 'Moral Policing'. It investigates discourse related to religious identities (Hindu, Muslim, Atheist) and the enforcement of moral standards, making these topics a core component of the linguistic analysis.
